## Independent confirmation of this card's premise, plus one correction it should carry downstream

Measured from a separate audit of the `Blocked-by:` reverse index (no knowledge of this card until dedupe — it was filed ~20 minutes before I looked):

```
.objectui-sha                 9602dc820450dda956843c6cfe5b329bcf88c757
that commit's date            2026-08-25T22:43:27Z   (objectui#6415, packaged actions on/off)
objectui PR #6828 merged      2026-08-30T06:30:15Z   (head 0d848bae5, Fixes objectui#6302)
```

⇒ The pin predates the fix by **five days**, so it cannot contain it. Ancestry judged on commit dates through the API rather than a local `merge-base` — this checkout of objectui is shallow (52 commits) and answers "not an ancestor" for everything.

### The correction, which lands on #12039 rather than here

**#12039's body carries `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#6302`, and that card is CLOSED** (2026-08-30). Any unlock sweep keyed on *"is the target closed"* would release #12039 today — and the release would be wrong, because the Key-2 ruling names the **pin bump**, not objectui#6302, as the predicate:

> land, bump the objectui pin; **then** converge the spec entry … on a follow-up carrying `Blocked-by:` **the pin bump**.

⇒ **This card is #12039's true unlock.** I have recorded the measurement and a corrected machine-readable line on #12039 (`issuecomment-5486863947`) so a body-keyed sweep does not release it on a closed target in the meantime. When this bump lands, #12039 becomes genuinely dispatchable — its Key 1 is already delivered, only Key 2 waits.

⛔ I did not repoint #12039's body line at this card myself: choosing between naming this card and naming the bump action is the `domain:spec` seat's call, and #12039 is unassigned in that lane.

本评论来自分诊座位(R+84,析取② + `pm:blocking` 推导施加)。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并。

## 一、补 `domain:*` —— 本卡此前是析取②(有 `pm:queue` 无 `domain:*`)

立卡人**正确地留白**并注明「`domain:*` label left to triage per the single-producer rule」。⇒ 判 **`domain:devx`**:落点是 `.objectui-sha` 与其 bump 工具链(`scripts/` 线),立卡人自己也判「historically `domain:devx`」,本席同意。

同时补 **`priority:p2`**(此前无优先级)—— 理由见第三节。

## 二、施加 `pm:blocking` —— 来自索引推导,⛔ 非手工判断

R+83 巡检 H14-A 行:

> `H14 #14027 targeted by 1 open card(s)' Blocked-by: line, body or comment (#12039), but NOT carrying pm:blocking`

前置条件已核:**#12039 open**,本卡 open 且此前无该标签。⇒ 施加即分诊 sweep 的推导步(`SKILL.md:100`;巡检 report-only)。

⭐ 而且这次推导与卡面**互相印证**:卡自己写「#12039's Key-2 half … is `pm:blocked` on THIS card」,索引独立地从另一端得出同一条边。

## 三、判据

**证据强度罕见地高** —— 立卡人给的不是「pin 看起来旧」,而是**内容探针**:

- `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` = `9602dc82…`,对应 objectui 提交日期 **2026-08-25 22:43Z**;
- 修复 PR objectui#6828 **MERGED 2026-08-30T06:30Z** ⇒ pin 比修复早**四天**;
- 在该 pin 上探内容:`translateFilterArray(params.filter)` **0 命中**,且 `aggregate-filter-lowering.test.ts` **不存在**。

⇒ ⭐ **内容探针而非祖先关系** —— 立卡人明写理由:「survives squash merges」。这是本轮见到的最干净的一条 pin 判据,验收标准也是可执行的一行:

```
git show $(cat .objectui-sha):packages/data-objectstack/src/aggregate-filter-lowering.test.ts
```

## 四、实施边界

- ⛔ **用仓内专用 bump 工具**(`pnpm objectui:refresh` / bump 脚本),**绝不手改** `.objectui-sha`。
- ⛔ **无搭车改动**(pin-bump 纪律)。
- ⚠️ bump 会把 objectui 从 08-25 推到 08-30 之后 —— **四天的其他改动一并进来**。⇒ PR 说明须写明这一点;若 CI 因无关改动红,那是 bump 的正常代价,⛔ 不是本卡失败。

## 五、定级

`priority:p2`:⛔ 无运行时缺陷;但它是一条**维护者已裁定的三步序**(2026-08-25「Ruled: A」)的**中间一步**,而第三步(#12039 Key-2)正 `pm:blocked` 在它上面。⇒ 一张 p2 卡卡着一条已裁定序列的推进。

## 查重

#12039(下游,open,`pm:blocked` 于本卡)· objectui#6302 / objectui PR #6828(上游第一步,已落地)。⛔ 无重复。

## PM patch round on [PR #14165](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/14165) — file-surface widening authorized, recorded here for audit

`domain:devx`, session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV`, R1. Reviewer of record.

**The red**: `Type Check · source gates` fails on `check:objectui-pin-citations` — 8 `packages/spec` sources cite the old pin `9602dc820` with objectui file:line anchors (api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts:64; component.test.ts:281/368/2440; component.zod.ts:645/1701/1878/2459). The red is this PR's own: the diff moved the pin those citations are checked against.

**Why this is not a forbidden rider**: the coupling is atomic — landing the citation updates alone reds main (citations would name a pin the repo doesn't build against), and landing the pin alone reds main the same way, so the gate's own remedy ("update the anchors and the sha together") defines the bump's true required surface. The pin-bump no-rider discipline forbids opportunistic extras, not the files the gate mechanically requires. Patch round sent to the ORIGINAL dev via SendMessage (context retained), instructed to follow the gate's remedy literally: re-measure every anchor at `d8ec8d6d4`, ⛔ never re-point a moved/dead read point silently.

**Clause ② handling**: the widened diff touches `packages/spec/src/**` incl. `component.zod.ts` ⇒ PATH limb fires. Dispatch tier was `claude-opus-5` < `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`claude-fable-5`, read from `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` at dispatch). Per the 2026-08-31 ruling the post-delivery review is done in-seat by the dispatching seat at tier: this seat's session runs at the contract-review tier and will review the spec-touching increment before ready/queue. Dev instructed to hang `needs:contract-review` with the push. Content limb remains `no` — citation/comment lines only; any non-comment spec change is a stop-and-report.

**Also from the terminal report, two items recorded**: the Zone-2 assumption "diff contains packages/console/dist" was falsified by the dev (dist is gitignored, build-time only) — correct falsification, the claim comment's file surface is amended accordingly; and the bump tooling's degraded-changeset behaviour on a shallow clone is being filed as a separate finding by this seat (the dev's measurement, on the record in its report).
